# RuleSetScope

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

The scopes of one rule-set assignment: every one must match for the
set's rules to apply.

Appears at: `/policy/rule_set_scopes`.
